Double Trouble

Common perk · Scoring bonus

On a scoring play, a double adds 5 points.

In-game card text

How it works

When your scoring play uses a double (both halves show the same number, including the double blank), the play gains +5 points for each copy.

  • Only the bone you just played is checked, not the doubles already on the table.
  • The open ends must still add up to a multiple of five; Double Trouble only adds to a play that already scores.
  • Pairs naturally with Golden Double, which then doubles the whole play including this bonus, and with Collector.
  • Cracked Doubles takes 5 points per copy back from any scoring double.

Worked example

You play 4-4 and the open ends total 15. With two copies of Double Trouble the play scores 15 + 10 = 25.
